The AR4's meshes are Annin Robotics' design files, under Annin Robotics' non-commercial licence (Annin Robotics Open Source Non-Commercial License Agreement, version 1.1, section 2), which allows educational, research and personal non-commercial use and forbids redistributing or hosting them in any form, derived files included (a converted or decimated mesh is one), and commercial use, without its written permission. No copy is hosted anywhere: this manifest names each file at Annin Robotics' own repository at a pinned commit with its sha256, and MIME downloads, checks, converts and decimates it on this machine, into the asset cache only, never into a saved or a run folder, a bundle or a package. Keep the logos and the names as they are, and do not use the Annin Robotics name to suggest endorsement. The description's kinematics and inertial values (ar4.urdf beside this file) are MIT, from ar4_ros_driver (LICENSE beside this file).
